name: Tambula Lehyam

sections.introduction: Tambula Lehyam also known as Thamboola lehyam is an herbal formulation which aids in curing respiratory disorders like cold, cough, and asthma to name a few. Tambula is referred to as a betel leaf which is the key ingredient of this formulation.
sections.ingredients:
Betel leaf extract (Piper betel) 
 Himamshu (Bambusa bambos) 
 Long pepper (Piper longum) 
 Cumin (Cuminum cyminum) 
 Sugar 
 Honey 

 Method of Preparation 
 Clean all the Piper betel leaves thoroughly and prepare a water decoction by boiling them in water. After the decoction is made, add powdered form of remaining ingredients and sugar and heat it till it attains a semisolid consistency. In the end honey is added and combined well.
sections.dosage: 5 grams twice a day with honey or lukewarm water after meals.
sections.indications:
Cold 
 Cough 
 Bronchitis 
 Asthma 
 Rhinitis 
 Whooping cough 
 Vomiting 
 Breath constraint
sections.contraindications:
Over dosage should be avoided. 
 There are no reported side effects of this formulation. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Tambula Lehyam 
 Introduction 
 Tambula Lehyam also known as Thamboola lehyam is an herbal formulation which aids in curing respiratory disorders like cold, cough, and asthma to name a few. Tambula is referred to as a betel leaf which is the key ingredient of this formulation. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Betel leaf extract (Piper betel) 
 Himamshu (Bambusa bambos) 
 Long pepper (Piper longum) 
 Cumin (Cuminum cyminum) 
 Sugar 
 Honey 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Clean all the Piper betel leaves thoroughly and prepare a water decoction by boiling them in water. After the decoction is made, add powdered form of remaining ingredients and sugar and heat it till it attains a semisolid consistency. In the end honey is added and combined well. 
 Dosage 
 5 grams twice a day with honey or lukewarm water after meals. 
 Indications 
 
 Cold 
 Cough 
 Bronchitis 
 Asthma 
 Rhinitis 
 Whooping cough 
 Vomiting 
 Breath constraint 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Over dosage should be avoided. 
 There are no reported side effects of this formulation. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
